scope:
Reproduce narrowly scoped mathematical counterexamples; not Hegel experiments.

Uses only standard-library arithmetic. Does not access network, invoke LLMs,
modify inputs, or infer empirical project performance.

epsilon_closeness_not_transitive.interpretation: An epsilon-diameter certificate is possible; pairwise epsilon edges do not define an equivalence relation.

aggregation_not_closed.interpretation: No deterministic autonomous z_dot=f(z) can reproduce both preparations.

nonlinear_convex_gradient_counterexample.interpretation: Local Schur stiffness bound survives; finite-amplitude monotone readout and endpoint attenuation do not follow from it.

zero_RL_fixed_initial_linkage.interpretation: The conserved initial state may vary across preparations; it is not controllable through external-flux history while R stays exactly zero.

SLS_topology_difference.interpretation: Both are SLS realizations but their named component parameters cannot be copied unchanged.

two_Maxwell_arms.interpretation: Complete eventual relaxation is independent of single-mode membership.
